name: Angel Profile
original_name: エンジェル・プロファイル
source: A "bishonen raising game" in the vein of the Princess Maker franchise, the player becomes the "mother" of a prince who was cursed by a dragon to become a child. With the help of two tutors, the angel Michael and the devil Mephisto, you'll need to raise the child back to his original age... but what will become of him depends on you!
translation: 这是一款继承《美少女梦工厂》系列风格的“美少女养成游戏”，玩家将成为一名被龙诅咒而变成孩子的王子的“母亲”。在天使米迦勒和魔鬼墨菲斯托两位导师的帮助下，你需要将孩子抚养回到原来的年龄……但他会变成什么样子取决于你！
